license_required.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board.

name.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board.

type.quote: The minimum qualifications for applicants for examination and license in each of the following specified classes of contractor: (A) Electrical contractor; (B) General building contractor; (C) General engineering contractor; (D) Heating, ventilating, and cooling contractor; (E) Multifamily contractor; (F) Piping contractor; (G) Plumbing contractor; (H) Residential contractor; or (l) Specialty contractor

required.quote: No license may be issued without examination pursuant to this subsection

experience_source.quote: No license may be issued without examination pursuant to this subsection

exams.name: Contractor licensing examination
exams.notes: The board shall hold at least one examination in each calendar quarter for each specific classification of contractor. Minimum qualifications and content set by board rule.
exams.quote: No license may be issued without examination pursuant to this subsection

interval_years.quote: A license issued under the provisions of this article expires one year from the date on which it is issued.

required.quote: If continuing education or other requirements are made a condition of license reinstatement after lapse, suspension, or revocation, these requirements must be satisfied before the license is reissued.

available.quote: the board may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to contractors licensed by other states, without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the board that the qualifications of the applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in this state

requirements.value: Reciprocity available where other state provides similar licensing; applicant must show qualifications equal to WV licensees, certify compliance with affidavit requirements, and pay the required fee. No written examination required.
requirements.quote: upon satisfactory proof furnished to the board that the qualifications of the applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in this state, and upon certification to the board as required by 30-42-15(c) of this code, and upon payment of the required fee.

exists.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Contractor Licensing Board.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a license to engage in business in this state as a contractor in one of the classifications set out in this article.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in this state in any activity as a contractor or submit a bid to perform work as a contractor, as defined in this article, unless that person holds a license issued under the provisions of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment, without legal excuse, of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project with reasonable diligence causing material injury
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful failure or refusal to complete a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence, thereby causing material injury to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the parties to the contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate violation of building laws or regulations of the state or any political subdivision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate violation of the building laws or regulations of the state or of any political subdivision thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay moneys when due for materials or services, or fraudulent denial of debt
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to pay any moneys when due for any materials free from defect, or services rendered in connection with the persons operations as a contractor when the person has the capacity to pay

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining a license or in connection with official licensing matters

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of this article or the board's rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate failure to comply in any material respect with the provisions of this article or the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or by a person other than the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting in the capacity of a contractor when not licensed or as a contractor by a person other than the person to whom the license is issued except as an employee of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting with intent to evade provisions of the article, including aiding unlicensed persons or allowing license misuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or deliberately acting with the intent to evade the provisions of this article by: (i) Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this article; (ii) combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person to perform an unauthorized act; (iii) allowing a license to be used by an unlicensed person; or (iv) attempting to assign, transfer, or otherwise dispose of a license or permitting the unauthorized use thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act as a contractor whereby substantial injury is sustained by another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act in the capacity as a contractor whereby substantial injury is sustained by another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing work not commensurate with the general standard for the contractor classification or below applicable building or construction codes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing work which is not commensurate with a general standard of the specific classification of contractor or which is below a building or construction code adopted by the municipality or county in which the work is performed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly employing persons who do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly employing a person or persons who do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to execute written contracts prior to performing contracting work in accordance with 30-42-10 of this code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to abide by an order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to abide by an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy a judgment or execution ordered by a magistrate court, circuit court, or arbitration board.

bonding_required.quote: The form of financial assurance may include, but is not limited to, a surety bond, a cash bond, a certificate of deposit, an irrevocable letter of credit, or performance insurance

insurance_required.quote: Has registered, and is in compliance, with the workers compensation fund and the employment security fund, as required by 23-1-1 et seq., and 21A-1-1 et seq., of this code

definition_quote.value: "Electrical contractor" means a person who engages in the business of contracting to install, erect, repair, or alter electrical equipment for the generation, transmission, or utilization of electrical energy.
definition_quote.quote: "Electrical contractor" means a person who engages in the business of contracting to install, erect, repair, or alter electrical equipment for the generation, transmission, or utilization of electrical energy.

methods_authorized.quote: engages in the business of contracting to install, erect, repair, or alter electrical equipment for the generation, transmission, or utilization of electrical energy

license_tiers.quote: "Electrical contractor" means a person who engages in the business of contracting to install, erect, repair, or alter electrical equipment for the generation, transmission, or utilization of electrical energy.

residential_project_definition.value: Occupancy of a structure for residential purposes for periods greater than 30 consecutive calendar days; residential structure means a building or structure used or intended to be used for residential occupancy, containing not more than three distinct floors above grade in any structural unit regardless of whether designed for one or more living units.
residential_project_definition.quote: "Residential occupancy" means occupancy of a structure for residential purposes for periods greater than 30 consecutive calendar days.

value: Work done exclusively by employees of the United States Government, the State of West Virginia, a county, municipality or municipal corporation, and any governmental subdivision or agency thereof
The sale or installation of a finished product, material or article, or merchandise which is not actually fabricated into and does not become a permanent fixed part of the structure
Work performed personally by an owner or lessee of real property on property the primary use of which is for agricultural or farming enterprise
A material supplier who renders advice concerning use of products sold and who does not provide construction or installation services
Work performed by a public utility company regulated by the West Virginia Public Service Commission and its employees
Repair work contracted by the owner of the equipment on an emergency basis in order to maintain or restore the operation of the equipment

Work performed by an employers regular employees, for which the employees are paid regular wages and not a contract price, on property owned or leased by the employer which is not intended for speculative sale or lease
Work personally performed on a structure by the owner or occupant thereof

Work performed when the specifications for the work have been developed or approved by engineering personnel employed by the owner of a facility by registered professional engineers licensed pursuant to the laws of this state when the work to be performed because of its specialized nature or process cannot be reasonably or timely contracted for within the general area of the facility
scope_exclusions.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this code, the following are exempt from licensure

qualifier_required.quote: No firm, partnership, corporation, association, or other entity may engage in contracting in this state unless an officer thereof holds a license issued pursuant to this article.

small_project_dollar_threshold_exemption.quote: where the cost of the undertaking is $5,000 or more for residential work or $25,000 or more for commercial work

utility_worker_exemption.quote: Work performed by a public utility company regulated by the West Virginia Public Service Commission and its employees
